blocking_issues: Missing closing CSS for .modal-close:hover rule - code is truncated
No keyboard navigation support - modals lack Escape key close, no Tab trapping
Missing ARIA labels on interactive elements (nav buttons, modal close, etc.)
No focus management - modals don't trap or restore focus
Color contrast issues - some text/background combinations fail WCAG AA (e.g., --gray:#6B7280 on --bg:#F5F0E8)
No skip-to-content link for keyboard users
Form inputs lack associated error announcements for screen readers
Login form lacks ARIA labels and roles for screen readers (affects blind/low-vision users)
CSS cut off mid-declaration in .modal-close:hover - incomplete stylesheet will cause rendering issues
No keyboard navigation/focus management visible for modals - violates WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard)
No ARIA attributes for modals (role='dialog', aria-modal, aria-labelledby) - violates WCAG 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value)
No focus trap implementation visible for modals - users can tab behind modal overlay
Color contrast issues: --gray (#6B7280) on white likely fails WCAG AA for small text (need 4.5:1)
Missing skip navigation link - violates WCAG 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks)
No visible form validation error announcements for screen readers
Modal close button '×' has no accessible label - screen reader will read 'button' with no context
